title: Cost audit
description: Weekly spend by project, vendor and workflow; outliers; cap recommendations.

steps.name: numbers
steps.prompt: Use the control plane API at $API_URL (curl is fine; JSON responses). Useful routes: GET /projects, GET /projects/:id, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id/events, GET /graph/:id, GET /workflows, GET /workflows/:id, GET /brief?hours=N, GET /audit?limit=N, GET /chores, GET /ledgers?status=signed, GET /proposals, POST /workflows, POST /projects, POST /projects/:id/continue, POST /chores, POST /tasks/:id/go. GET /sessions (last 7 days via created_at) and GET /brief?hours=168. Compute spend by project, by vendor, by workflow, and per session median and p95. Identify the five most expensive sessions and read their events to say why (long transcripts, retries, repeated parks). Write COSTS.md with tables and a chart as an ASCII bar list.

steps.name: recommend
steps.prompt: From COSTS.md propose per-workflow spend caps (p95 x 1.3), vendor routing changes where a cheaper vendor matches the task, and any chore whose cost is not justified by its output. Append a Recommendations section with the JSON edits.
